meta.name: intelligent-routing
meta.description: Automatic agent selection and intelligent task routing. Analyzes user requests and automatically selects the best specialist agent(s) without requiring explicit user mentions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析请求并自动匹配最合适的专家助手
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在搭建多智能体系统,希望任务自动找对处理人。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze requests and automatically match the best specialist agent.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multi-agent systems and want automatic request routing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先自动分析你的请求，判断涉及哪些技术领域和复杂度，再自动调用最合适的专家技能来回答，并在回复开头说明会用到哪个专家。
howto.when: 每次你提出请求时都会触发。任务简单且单一领域就直接调用对应专家；涉及多个领域则交给总协调者；请求含糊不清就先追问。

say.text: 帮我检查登录功能有没有安全漏洞
say.note: 会触发安全审计和后端专家来处理。

say.text: 给这个页面加一个暗色模式切换按钮
say.note: 会自动调用前端专家来改代码。

say.text: 做一个带实时通知的聊天应用
say.note: 会交给总协调者统筹多个专家完成。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically analyzes your request, identifies the technical domains and complexity, then invokes the most suitable specialist agent(s) and tells you which expertise is being applied at the start of the reply.
howto.when_en: Triggers on every user request. Simple single-domain tasks directly invoke the matching agent; multi-domain tasks go to the orchestrator; vague requests are clarified first.

say_en.text: Check the login flow for security vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Triggers security auditor and backend specialist.

say_en.text: Add a dark mode toggle button to this page.
Build a chat app with real-time notifications.
say_en.note: Sends it to the orchestrator to coordinate agents.
